apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once per run (Apify synthetic start event; priced per GB of run memory, 1 GB minimum). Target ~$0.001 for a typical 256 MB–1 GB start.

cnpj-card.eventDescription: Charged once per SUCCESSFUL CNPJ company card (registry record fetched and normalized: identity, status, CNAE, address, QSA summary, Markdown card and optional RAG chunks). Invalid CNPJs, not found, rate-limited after retries, auth errors and provider failures are free.
